request.style: English, deep male baritone solo with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, hopeful and determined mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I do not consider myself
To have taken hold of it yet
The race is not ended now
My feet are still on the ground

[Verse]
One thing I do with my whole heart
Leaving the shadows of yesterday
Not looking back at what I was
Only forward to what is true

[Chorus]
Forgetting what lies behind
Straining toward what lies ahead
I press on toward the goal
To win the prize of God's call

[Verse]
Mature in my mind and soul
Thinking this way every day
If I see things differently
God will make it clear to me

[Chorus]
Forgetting what lies behind
Straining toward what lies ahead
I press on toward the goal
To win the prize of God's call

[Bridge]
Live up to what we have attained
Imitate the pattern we see
Keep your eyes on those who live
As we do in Christ Jesus

[Chorus]
Forgetting what lies behind
Straining toward what lies ahead
I press on toward the goal
To win the prize of God's call

[Outro]
To win the prize of God's call
In Christ Jesus forevermore
